row.reason: Forestar develops raw land into finished residential lots and sells them to homebuilders. Green Brick is mainly a homebuilder that sells homes to homebuyers. It does land development, but mostly for its own builders, and it adds mortgage and title services. The two overlap in land development and the residential housing end market. Their main products and buyers differ, so this is adjacent.
